disagreements.source_a: Roblox Den lists ELEMENTAL26, MERDEKA and WORMHYPE as active, with MUTATION2, YEEHAW and DIVING marked check.
disagreements.source_b: RBX Radar lists six active codes, including CONTRA, POTIONSSS and MUTATION2, while PC Gamer retains a much broader list.
disagreements.confirmed: Freetins did not redeem the codes. The table preserves the source status in each context instead of calling every row confirmed.

disagreements.source_a: Roblox Den calls the reward a Kerupuk Lantern, and PC Gamer calls it a special lantern.
disagreements.source_b: Dexerto reports two Mutation II Potions.
disagreements.confirmed: The table uses the more specific lantern description without claiming a Freetins redemption.

disagreements.source_a: Roblox Den and RBX Radar report two Mutation II Potions.
disagreements.source_b: Some current coverage reports an Ember Heart instead.
disagreements.confirmed: The table uses the two-potion agreement and leaves the account-specific grant unconfirmed.

unverified_summary: Freetins did not redeem these entries. Current sources disagree on the active set and on some rewards, especially MERDEKA and ELEMENTAL26. Each row states its source context, and disputed rows remain sourced claims rather than first-hand confirmations.

next_change.pattern: Publisher announcements can change rewards and requirements. No fixed code-release schedule is established.
